> This PCB will be designed with the 74LS Logic Gate Series and the purpose is to show how ALUS and Low-level programming works. With my project this will help new electronic hobbyist & enthusiasts how logic works in digital electronics, consider this project as the stepping stone. The inputs will be side switches so people who will see this and consider building it can manually control it. And each logic gate output will have its LEDS, since the 74LS Logic Gates cannot provide much through sourcing the LED, we will be using NPN transistors (SINKING) to counter this. Lastly, this will help people how binary addition works through hardware!
